content.title: How to watch Warriors vs Nuggets: TV channels, times, and streaming
content.text: The Warriors face the Nuggets in Denver.Billy CaddenThe Warriors head to Denver tonight in the middle of a season that just keeps throwing punches. Already without Jimmy Butler for the year and Steph Curry for an extended stretch due to his lingering knee injury, Golden State took another hit last weekend when Moses Moody suffered a ruptured patellar tendon and was ruled out for the season. Despite all of that, the Dubs are still fighting, entering tonight at 36-38 and holding onto the No. 10 seed as they inch closer to what is an inevitable Play-In appearance. After dropping 8 of 9, they’ve steadied things a bit with a 3-game win streak heading into this tough road matchup.Standing in their way is Nikola Jokić and a Nuggets team firmly in the thick of the Western Conference playoff race. Denver sits at 47-28, currently 4th in the West but just 1.5 games behind the Lakers for 3rd and only two games ahead of the Rockets in 6th. With that much at stake, the Nuggets have plenty of motivation to protect home court. The Warriors, meanwhile, are simply trying to stay afloat and buy time until Curry can return. Golden State enters as an 11.5-point underdog, but as they’ve shown all season, they’re still capable of making things interesting no matter who’s on the floor.The Warriors vs Nuggets game tips off tonight at 7:00 p.m. PST, and fans everywhere can watch it with Sling TV and Peacock.When is Warriors vs Nuggets? What: Golden State Warriors @ Denver Nuggets When: March 29, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. PST Where: Ball Arena, Denver, CO TV: NBC and Peacock How to stream the Warriors vs Nuggets game without cableSince the game was originally set to pit Steph Curry against arguably the best player in the world, Nikola Jokić, it will air nationally on NBC and Peacock. While we won’t get to see Curry suit up, the game itself is still easy to watch since all of the top streaming platforms carry NBC in at least one of their base packages. For tonight’s game specifically, you could just sign up for Peacock to catch the action, but we recommend signing up for Sling TV so you can tune into way more Warriors games heading into the playoffs.Here in the Bay Area, you can sign up for Sling Select for just $29.99/month to watch tonight’s game, making it one of the cheapest monthly subscriptions of any platform with live TV and sports. From there, you can upgrade to Sling Blue for $54.99/month. But with Sling’s limited-time offer giving you half off your first month of Sling Orange & Blue, you could sign up for the platform’s top-tier subscription for just $34.99 for the first month. Here are all the ways to catch tonight’s game with Sling here in the Bay: Sling TV 3-Month Prepay (Starting at $49.99 - $159.99 then monthly recurring payments) Sling TV Select (Starting at $29.99/month) Sling TV Blue (Starting at $54.99/month) Sling TV Orange & Blue (Starting at $69.99/month; half off your first month) As always, make sure Sling carries NBC within your specific zip code before signing up. If for any reason it doesn’t, you can use any of these other four top streaming platforms to watch the Warriors vs Nuggets game tonight: fuboTV ($48.99 for the first month, then $73.99/month with a 7-day free trial) DIRECTV STREAM ($89.99/month; there are no free trials right now for the base plan) Hulu + Live TV ($89.99/month with a 3-day free trial; also includes Disney+ and ESPN+) YouTube TV ($67.99/month for the first three months, then $82.99/month with a variable free trial) March 29, 2026Andrew Koopman is a freelance writer who's been producing content since 2020. If he's not writing, Andrew is almost certainly watching sports (go Warriors!) or planning his next adventure as he attempts to visit all 50 states in the next few years.
